source.description:
PROBLEM: GlobalSpecialistOverrideSchema.safeParse({ execution: { model: 'x', fallback_model: 'y' }, skills: { paths: [] } }).success === false. The schema requires unrelated nullable execution fields to be present even when the operator only wants to override fallback fields. Breaks the documented sparse-overlay contract (overrides should be additive on the canonical layer; user.json should accept any sparse shape that names allowlisted paths).

SUCCESS: GlobalSpecialistOverrideSchema accepts sparse execution objects that contain only fallback_model / fallback_models without requiring unrelated execution keys. Existing strict validation for unknown/blocked keys remains.

SCRUTINY: medium (override schema controls what reaches the runtime; sloppy widening can leak blocked fields).

SCOPE: src/specialist/global-config.ts (GlobalSpecialistOverrideSchema).

NON_GOALS: do not change the loader merge precedence; do not add new allowlist entries.

CONSTRAINTS: keep the blocked-field stripping path intact. Sparse acceptance applies only to allowlisted execution fields.

VALIDATION: flip the describe.skip on tests/unit/specialist/schema.test.ts:119 ("global override schema accepts singular and plural fallback shapes") to describe; cases must pass. Run bun --bun vitest run tests/unit/specialist/schema.test.ts.

OUTPUT: schema fix + green test + bd close referencing unitAI-gp7nq.9 and this bead.

DISCOVERED FROM: unitAI-gp7nq.9 test-engineer chain (job b821af).
